description: Use this when the user wants to convert a PDF to Excel, convert PDF to Excel, extract a table from a PDF, convert PDF table to Excel, PDF to CSV, PDF to XLSX, get a bank statement PDF to Excel, or turn a PDF to spreadsheet. It reads the tables in a text-based PDF and returns an Excel workbook (one sheet per table) and a ZIP of CSV files, with column types and a preview of the first rows. Handles up to 15 MB and 50 pages. Does not read scanned or image-only pages (no OCR), does not edit the PDF, and keeps files for about 1 hour. Do not use for a PDF that is only a form to fill or for reading a PDF as plain text.

column_types.description: Force a column type when the detected one is wrong, e.g. [{"table":1,"column":3,"type":"text"}]. The widget's type switches send this.

column.description: 1-based column number in that table, e.g. 3.

table.description: 1-based table number shown in the result, e.g. 1.

type.description: The type to force for that column, e.g. date.

file.description: The text-based PDF that holds the tables, e.g. statement.pdf or price-list.pdf.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

merge_tables.description: true (default): join the last table on a page to the first on the next page only when their column count and whitespace-normalized source headers match; drop the repeated header.

pages.description: Pages to read, e.g. 1-3,5. Default: every page (first 50).

name: convert_pdf_tables
title: Convert PDF tables to Excel
